sessions.title: Accounts, rules and application foundation
sessions.acceptance: Owner approval recorded; two users register/login with separate protected profiles; unauthorized access denied; schema integration and application build pass.
sessions.manual: Use two accounts; verify logout, recovery and profile isolation; review the corrected energy example and final-turn ruling.

sessions.title: Playable online PvP
sessions.acceptance: Two authenticated browsers finish a complete persisted match; duplicate commands apply once; stale commands rejected; hidden information protected; reconnect restores correct state; result/rating applied once.
sessions.manual: Complete a match in two browsers; reconnect one; send concurrent duplicate and stale requests; inspect both network views for leaked secrets.

sessions.title: Community and user management
sessions.acceptance: Users interact through persistent feed and relationships; blocks/visibility respected; reports reach moderators; only authorized moderators can act; suspended users cannot mutate the platform.
sessions.manual: Create/comment/like with two users, then block; attempt cross-user edits and ordinary-user moderation; resolve a report and inspect the audit trail.

sessions.title: Integrated validation, fixes and handoff
sessions.acceptance: Local integrated platform passes observed core journeys, engine tests, integration tests, typecheck and production build; any unresolved critical issue blocks acceptance; source and ledgers are committed with no claimed deployment.
sessions.manual: Repeat one complete journey with two independent browsers; confirm blocked/suspended permissions, replay, reconnect and responsive controls.
